annotations.title: See an event's team: co-hosts and door staff (hosts)

description: Lists the team of an event the signed-in person hosts or co-hosts, as the organizer dashboard's Team panel does: each Co-host and Door staff member with their role, the last four digits of their number, and whether they have joined (signed in) or are still pending. `eventIdOrName` is the event id or its name as the host says it ("my quince"). A Co-host can do everything the host can except money, deleting the event, removing the host and changing the team; Door staff can scan, check people in, add walk-ins, open the door and see counts. Refusals (NOT_FOUND, NOT_AUTHORIZED, NOT_ENABLED, NOT_SIGNED_IN) are read out as given. It requires a personal connector token.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or the event name as the host says it.
